crossRefs.note: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have…
namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having…
We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ…
if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News…
We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in…
who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly…
The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who…

translations.web: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
translations.bsb: “To you, O men, I call out, and my cry is to the sons of men.
translations.kjv: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
translations.asv: Unto you, O men, I call; And my voice is to the sons of men.
